ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high-intensity (white) pixels comprising approximately 35% of the visible surface area against a dominant low-intensity (black) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-contrast white contiguous blobs located on the lateral-distal regions of both lobes, bordered by a central dark pigmentation corridor; left lobe patch contains four distinct dark focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with steep interior pixel gradients meeting at a central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and deep valleys spanning the entire trailing boundary from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the upper boundary of both lobes, sweeping upward and outward to tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular dark pixel clusters embedded within the white lateral patches of both lobes, specifically four on the left and two on the right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, presenting as high-contrast, irregular textured masses.
other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable jaggedness and irregular pixel loss at the extreme right tip compared to the left.
